proof:
For nonsingleton $P$, $\Sigma$ is positive definite on $E$, since its quadratic form is the mean of the squares of all projections onto $z-\bar z$. Write $a_z=\alpha+\ell\cdot(z-\bar z)$ with $\ell\in E$. Averaging the balance gives $\Sigma\ell-\alpha w=0$. Substituting $\ell=\alpha\Sigma^{-1}w$ gives the roots and the value at $z_0$. The mean square is $\alpha^2+\ell^{\mathsf T}\Sigma\ell=\alpha^2(1+\Delta)$, giving the stated mass. Substitution proves the converse. For a singleton the equation and formulas are immediate.

On the consecutive chain, $\bar z=(N-1)/2$ and $\Sigma=(N^2-1)/12$ by summing squares. The smallest bracket occurs at an endpoint and equals $1-6|z_0-\bar z|/(N+1)$. At the left middle of an even chain $w=-1/2$, so $\Delta=3/(4m^2-1)$. Substitution yields all claimed formulas, including failure of strict positivity at $m=1$. In actual planar homothetic proper caps the balance is the criticality condition from the section-length weights, but these scalar formulas require only the displayed balance.

statement:
Let $P\subset\mathbb R^n$ be finite, $z_0\in P$, and $a_z>0$ affine on $P$ with $\sum_z(z-z_0)a_z=0$. Write $N=|P|$, $\bar z=N^{-1}\sum_z z$, $E=\operatorname{span}(P-\bar z)$, $\Sigma=N^{-1}\sum_z(z-\bar z)(z-\bar z)^{\mathsf T}$ on $E$, $w=z_0-\bar z$, and $\Delta=w^{\mathsf T}\Sigma^{-1}w$. For a singleton take $\Delta=0$ and omit the inverse term. With $\alpha=N^{-1}\sum_z a_z$ and $a_0=a_{z_0}$,
$$
a_z=\alpha[1+w^{\mathsf T}\Sigma^{-1}(z-\bar z)],\qquad
a_0=\alpha(1+\Delta),\qquad
\sum_z a_z^2=\frac{Na_0^2}{1+\Delta}.
$$
Conversely the displayed affine array for any $\alpha>0$ satisfies the balance and is admissible exactly when all brackets are positive. For $P=\{0,\ldots,N-1\}$, $N\ge2$, this is equivalent to $|z_0-\bar z|<(N+1)/6$. At $N=2m,z_0=m-1$, feasibility is equivalent to $m\ge2$, and $\sum_z a_z^2=2ma_0^2(4m^2-1)/(4m^2+2)$. For $a_0^2=4/9$ the latter mass is $4m(4m^2-1)/(9(2m^2+1))$, equal to $112/33$ when $m=4$.
title: Covariance formula for positive affine planar critical-cap roots
